specs.title: Installable as a PWA: manifest, icons, colours, an offline shell and an update toast
specs.goal: The app can be installed on a desktop, a tablet or a phone and opens in its own window with the lead-ring icon and the app's own colours; a service worker keeps the app shell available without a network, a toast offers to reload when a deploy has landed, and data still comes from the API only.

specs.title: The chat says what happened to a turn, deletes many conversations at once, and brings a cited row into view
specs.goal: Hovering or focusing the ring beside an answer plays its turn and opens a popover with that turn's state, the reason when it ended incomplete, its steps, duration and model, the same live and after a reload; the empty chat's ring does the same with the chat's own status (model, today's calls against the ceiling, the tool-round bound); the conversation list deletes the selected or all shown conversations with one confirmation and one request; and an offer opened from a chat citation has its marked shortlist row scrolled into the list pane.

archive.title: The debt behind v0.5.0 is paid down without a change in behaviour: notes, docs, compose, version, leaks, and the Lombok sweep
archive.goal: The afternoon-sized debt is paid: the three working-notes files sit at or under 85 % of their budget with the reasoning moved to `docs/decisions/`, no document claims a gap the build has closed, `.env.example` and the placeholders are held equal by a test, the compose stack reports three healthy services, the two leaks are closed, the catalog literals are keys, and every backend class whose constructor only assigned its fields carries `@RequiredArgsConstructor` — with every request mapping, response field, migration and configuration key meaning exactly what it meant before, and the service as AOT-compatible for GraalVM as it is today.
